requirements.test_case: Compare the left and right lamp exterior geometry in drawings.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall satisfy the same colorimetric requirements.
requirements.test_case: Perform colorimetric measurement of the left and right lamps.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics; this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.test_case: Compare goniophotometric results of the left and right lamps.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, all logos that are not vehicle manufacturer or body manufacturer logos shall be prohibited.
requirements.test_case: Check that any logo is a vehicle or body manufacturer logo.

requirements.text: In the case of lamps incorporating a manufacturer logo, only two lateral logos (one on each side) or one central logo shall be fitted on the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the drawings for logos and count the rear logos.

requirements.text: On vehicles whose external shape is asymmetrical, the requirements of paragraph 5.5 shall be satisfied so far as is possible.
requirements.test_case: Review the vehicle body shape and the lamp symmetry justification.

requirements.text: Lamps shall be permitted to be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Verify colour, position, geometric visibility and wiring of each function in the module.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF.
requirements.test_case: Perform photometric and colorimetric test of each function alone.

requirements.text: When a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other functions which can be switched ON together with them, the colour requirements of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Measure stop lamp colour with the position and stop functions both on.

requirements.text: Stop lamps and direction-indicator lamps shall not be reciprocally incorporated.
requirements.test_case: Check the design to confirm no shared emitting surface with a direction indicator.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), whose apparent surface is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent or tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure the 60% quadrilateral fill or the 75 mm gap on the projected apparent surface.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (b) or (c), composed of two lamps marked "D" or two independent retro reflectors, shall be installed in such a way that either the projection of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of the two lamps or retro reflectors occupies not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projections of the said apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis, or the minimum distance between the facing edges of the apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axis of two lamps or two independent retro reflectors does not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval markings and measure the 60% fill or the 75 mm gap.

requirements.text: A lamp in the shape of a band or strip shall be permitted to be part of an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp geometry in drawings.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.4.11.1., subparagraph (d) shall fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Check for Y markings and verify against the 5.7.2.1 criteria.

requirements.text: Where two or more lamps and/or two or more separate apparent surfaces are included into the same lamp body and/or have a common outer lens, these shall not be considered as an interdependent lamp system.
requirements.test_case: Review the approval documentation for the classification of the lamps in the common body.

requirements.text: The illumination of a band or strip lamp surface shall be provided by not less than two light sources placed as close as possible to the ends.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the LED layout for at least two sources near the band ends.

requirements.text: The light-emitting surface of a band or strip lamp shall be permitted to be constituted by a number of juxtaposed elements on condition that these individual light-emitting surfaces, when projected on a transverse plane, fulfil the requirements of paragraph 5.7.2.1.
requirements.test_case: Check the projected element surfaces against the 5.7.2.1 criteria.

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall be placed symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle, extending on both sides to within at least 0.4 m of the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure symmetry and the distance to the vehicle's outer edge (at most 0.4 m).

requirements.text: Two lamps or an even number of lamps in the shape of a band or strip shall have a length of not less than 0.8 m.
requirements.test_case: Measure the band length (at least 0.8 m).

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Monitor intensity over time while the lamp is on and check the control logic.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be flashing lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle functions and verify flashing operation if an emergency stop signal is implemented.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp shall be permitted to vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometry with the other functions on and off and check compliance.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp shall be permitted to vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Check that any ambient-dependent variation stays within the lamp's technical provisions.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp shall be permitted to vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp function matrix; if combined, verify photometry in each mode against the relevant lamp provisions.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check on vehicle that red light from the rear lamps is not visible from the front (Annex 4 Zone 1 check).

requirements.text: For the visibility of red light towards the front of a vehicle, with the exception of a red rearmost side-marker lamp, there shall be no direct visibility of the apparent surface of a red lamp if viewed by an observer moving within Zone 1 in a transverse plane situated 25 m in front of the vehicle (see Annex 4).
requirements.test_case: Observer check within Zone 1, transverse plane 25 m in front of the vehicle per Annex 4.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the no-direct-visibility requirement of paragraphs 5.10.4.1. and 5.10.4.2. shall be deemed fulfilled if the luminous intensity of the red light emitted to the front and/or the white light emitted to the rear, as verified during type approval of the lamps, is not more than 0.25 cd per lamp taking into account the influence of the vehicle body if applicable.
requirements.test_case: Check lamp type-approval photometry: forward red intensity ≤0.25 cd per lamp including body influence.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Wiring diagram review and functional switching test on vehicle.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.test_case: Check approval marking ('Y') and verify all light sources switch simultaneously.

requirements.text: The concealment of lamps shall be prohibited, with the exception of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps, which may be concealed when they are not in use.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle inspection confirming no concealment device covers the rear lamp functions.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall emit amber or red light.
requirements.test_case: Confirm whether ESS is realised via the stop lamps; if so verify red emitted colour and flash operation.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light against red chromaticity limits.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall emit white light.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light against white chromaticity limits / approval document check.

requirements.text: The stop lamp shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric measurement of emitted light against red chromaticity limits.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall emit red light.
requirements.test_case: Colorimetric check of the reflected light against the red chromaticity limits.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Count the installed lamps of each function on the vehicle against the R48 paragraph 6 requirements.

requirements.text: Any lamp shall be permitted to be installed on movable components, provided that the conditions specified in paragraphs 5.18, 5.19 and 5.20 are fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Review vehicle drawings for lamp mounting on movable components and check paragraphs 5.18 to 5.20.

requirements.text: Rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors, triangular as well as non-triangular, shall be permitted to be installed on movable components only if the condition in paragraph 5.18.1 is fulfilled.
requirements.test_case: Check the mounting location; if on a tailgate, verify the requirements at all fixed positions.

requirements.text: At all fixed positions of the movable components, the rear position lamps, rear direction-indicators and rear retro-reflectors on the movable components shall meet all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for those lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure position, visibility, colour and photometry at each fixed position of the movable component.

requirements.text: In the case where the functions referred to in paragraph 5.18. are obtained by an assembly of two lamps marked "D" (see paragraph 2.4.11.1.), only one of the lamps shall meet the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements for those lamps at all fixed positions of the movable components.
requirements.test_case: Check lamp markings and mounting; verify one lamp at all fixed positions.

requirements.text: Where additional lamps for the functions of paragraph 5.18. are fitted and are switched ON when the movable component is in any fixed open position, these additional lamps shall satisfy all the position, geometric visibility and photometric requirements applicable to the lamps installed on the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle design for additional lamps and verify their position, visibility and photometry.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp with the movable component in non-normal positions for glare or discomfort.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Cycle the movable component and verify the lamp returns to the specified position.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.test_case: Measure the hidden percentage of the apparent surface along the reference axis at each fixed position of the movable component.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.test_case: Verify that additional lamps switch on and meet the requirements when more than 50% is hidden.

requirements.text: If the requirement of paragraph 5.21. is not practicable, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road, for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road, this paragraph not applying to retro-reflectors.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle for the user notice if more than 50% hiding occurs.

requirements.text: Any temporary fail-safe replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp shall be permitted, provided that the replacement function in case of a failure is similar in colour, main intensity and position to the function that has ceased to operate and provided that the replacement device remains operational in its original safety function.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a position lamp failure and verify the replacement function's colour, intensity and position.

requirements.text: During replacement of the light-signalling function of a rear position lamp, a tell-tale on the dashboard (paragraph 2.3.5. of this Regulation) shall indicate occurrence of a temporary replacement and need for repair.
requirements.test_case: Simulate a failure and check that the dashboard tell-tale activates.

requirements.text: In the entire intensity range, the specific prescribed ratio between the luminous intensities of two lamps, if applicable, shall be maintained throughout variation transitions.
requirements.test_case: Measure the stop and position intensities through the transitions and verify the ratio.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b, rear position lamps of category R2 and stop lamps of category S2 with variable luminous intensity control, which respond simultaneously to one or more of the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., shall be permitted.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp category markings and the intensity control conditions against paragraphs 5.26.1 and 5.26.2.

requirements.text: The intensity of all the lamps mentioned in paragraph 5.26., when combined, grouped or reciprocally incorporated, shall vary all together in the same manner and in a similar proportion.
requirements.test_case: Measure the intensities across the control conditions and verify proportional variation.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b and rear position lamps shall be permitted to increase or decrease the luminous intensity, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, in relation to the following conditions: ambient lighting, fog, snowfall, rain, spray, dust clouds, and contamination of the light emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Check the lamp specification for variable-intensity control and verify intensity stays within R148/R7 limits under each condition.

requirements.text: Independently from the environmental conditions in paragraph 5.26.1, rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b and rear position lamps shall be permitted to decrease the luminous intensity, within the limits prescribed in the pertinent UN Regulations, as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 20 km/h or the distance to the following vehicle is equal or less than 20 m.
requirements.test_case: Verify the control logic reduces intensity only at ≤20 km/h or ≤20 m following distance, within the photometric limits.

requirements.text: Rear direction indicator lamps of category 2b and rear position lamps shall be permitted to keep an intensity decrease already activated active as long as the vehicle speed is equal or less than 50 km/h.
requirements.test_case: Vehicle test confirming the intensity decrease ends above 50 km/h.

requirements.text: Stop lamps of category S4 and rear fog lamps of category F2 shall be permitted to produce variable luminous intensity, based on the conditions listed in paragraphs 5.26.1. and 5.26.2., independently from the other lamps.
requirements.test_case: Check the stop lamp approval category (S4) and its variable-intensity control behaviour.

requirements.text: Lamps with variable luminous intensity under paragraphs 5.26.1 to 5.26.3 shall show no sharp variation of intensity during transition.
requirements.test_case: Record luminous intensity over time during transitions and confirm a smooth change.

requirements.text: The variable luminous intensity functions described in paragraphs 5.26.1 to 5.26.3 shall be permitted to be set by the driver to static luminous intensities.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle HMI for an option that sets static intensity.

requirements.text: The lamp shall have no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity; however, no account is taken of obstacles, if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.test_case: Check the installed lamp on the vehicle for obstructions within the prescribed geometric visibility angles.

requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, the applicant shall furnish proof that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.test_case: Photometric check of the unobstructed portion of the lamp against the device approval values.

requirements.text: When the lamp is at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1., the photometric field of measurements of the installed optical unit shall be permitted to be reduced to 5º below the horizontal.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height and check the photometric field down to 5° below horizontal.

requirements.text: When the lamp is at less than 750 mm above the ground measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1., the vertical angle of geometric visibility below the horizontal shall be permitted to be reduced to 5º.
requirements.test_case: Measure the mounting height per 5.8.1 and verify downward geometric visibility.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, the geometric visibility requirements shall be fulfilled when all its interdependent lamps are operated together.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility with all interdependent lamps operated together.

requirements.text: A LED module shall not be required to be replaceable if so stated in the communication sheet of the component type approval.
requirements.test_case: Check the R148 communication sheet for the LED module replaceability statement.

requirements.text: All lamps (devices) shall, where applicable, be type approved according to the corresponding device Regulations as specified in the relevant subparagraphs of paragraph 6 of this Regulation when installed on a vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the approval markings and certificates for each function.

requirements.text: A light-signalling lamp incorporating a manufacturer logo shall be type approved according to the requirements of the UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp for a logo and check its R148 approval.

requirements.text: One reversing lamp device shall be fitted on motor vehicles of category M1 and on all other vehicles with a length not exceeding 6,000 mm.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle installation drawing for the number of reversing lamp devices fitted.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 23, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the R23/R148 approval certificate and the approval marking on the lamp.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in height not less than 250 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground; for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,400 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the illuminating surface above ground on the unladen vehicle.

requirements.text: The reversing lamp shall be positioned in length at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify on the vehicle installation drawing that the lamp is at the rear.

requirements.text: Reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall have a geometric visibility defined by angle α = 15° upwards and 5° downwards, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Verify the apparent surface visibility over α +15°/−5° on the installed lamp or by CAD.

requirements.text: Reversing lamp devices installed at the rear of the vehicle shall have a geometric visibility defined by angle β = 45° to right and to left if there is only one device, and 45° outwards and 30° inwards if there are two, as specified in paragraph 2.10.7.
requirements.test_case: Verify horizontal visibility angles β on the installed lamp or by CAD.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the reversing lamp shall be such that the lamp can be switched ON only if the reverse gear is engaged and if the device which controls the starting and stopping of the propulsion system is in such a position that operation of the propulsion system is possible.
requirements.test_case: Functional test on the vehicle: the lamp turns ON only with reverse engaged and the propulsion system operable.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the reversing lamp shall be mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the component-regulation approval for a failure tell-tale requirement; if one applies, verify on the vehicle that a tell-tale lights when the reversing lamp LED module fails.

requirements.text: The stop lamp devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the R7/R148 approval certificate and the approval marking on the lamp.

requirements.text: The stop lamps of the vehicle shall consist of two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device on all categories of vehicles.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle installation drawing for two S1/S2 rear stop lamps plus one S3/S4 device.

requirements.text: On M1 and N1 category vehicles, the S1 or S2 category stop lamp device whose apparent surface points in the direction of the reference axis farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall be not more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure the distance from the apparent surface edge to the vehicle's extreme outer edge on the installed vehicle.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned above the ground not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and if the optional lamps are not installed).
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower and upper edge heights of the apparent surface above ground on the unladen vehicle.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation to confirm the lamp sits at the rear.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be geometrically visible 15° above and 15° below the horizontal; however, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°, and where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Check vertical geometric visibility angles on the installed vehicle or a CAD model.

requirements.text: S1 or S2 category stop lamp devices shall be geometrically visible within 45° to the left and to the right of the longitudinal axis of the vehicle; however, for stop lamps of categories S1 and S2 mounted below 750 mm, the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Check geometric visibility angles on the installed vehicle or a CAD model.

requirements.text: Stop lamp devices shall be oriented towards the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the lamp orientation on the installed vehicle.

requirements.text: All stop lamps shall be switched ON simultaneously when the braking system provides the relevant signal defined in UN Regulations Nos. 13 and 13-H.
requirements.test_case: Apply the brake and verify that all stop lamps light simultaneously.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the stop lamps shall be provided if required by the component regulation.
requirements.test_case: Review the R7/R148 approval for a failure-monitoring requirement and test the tell-tale on simulated LED failure.

requirements.text: The rear position lamps shall be two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.test_case: Check the R7/R148 type-approval certificate and markings, and confirm two lamps are installed on the vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle; this condition shall not apply to the optional rear lamps.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the installed vehicle the distance from the outermost point of the apparent surface to the vehicle's outer edge (≤400 mm).

requirements.text: The rear position lamp height above the ground shall be not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm, or 2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm and the optional lamps are not installed.
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the apparent surface above ground on the unladen vehicle.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect the vehicle installation drawing or the vehicle to confirm the lamp is fitted at the rear.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm, the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Verify geometric visibility of the apparent surface over the horizontal angles on the vehicle or in CAD.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°, and where an optional lamp is mounted above 2,100 mm the upward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify vertical geometric visibility angles considering the mounting height.

requirements.text: As an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., for M1 and N1 category vehicles at the discretion of the manufacturer, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.test_case: Confirm whether a rear side-marker lamp is fitted and the option is chosen; if so, verify 45°/45° horizontal visibility.

requirements.text: As an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., for M1 and N1 category vehicles at the discretion of the manufacturer, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall have a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: If the option is used, verify 15° up/down (5° down below 750 mm) vertical visibility.

requirements.text: As an alternative to paragraph 6.10.5.1., for M1 and N1 category vehicles at the discretion of the manufacturer, and only if a rear side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the rear position lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 square centimetres, and the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
requirements.test_case: If the option is used, measure the unobstructed apparent surface (≥12.5 cm², excluding non-transmitting retro-reflector area).

requirements.text: The electrical connection of the rear position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11.
requirements.test_case: Review the wiring diagram and check that position lamps switch with front position, end-outline, side-marker and registration lamps per 5.11.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale for the rear position lamps shall be provided as mandatory, combined with that of the front position lamps; this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON.
requirements.test_case: Check on the vehicle that the position-lamp tell-tale illuminates when the lamps are switched on.

requirements.text: A tell-tale indicating failure of the rear position lamps shall be mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Check the R7/R148 approval for any failure tell-tale requirement and verify the tell-tale operates on simulated LED failure.

requirements.text: Additional retro-reflecting devices and materials (including two retro-reflectors not complying with paragraph 6.14.4. below) shall be permitted, provided they do not impair the effectiveness of the mandatory lighting and light-signalling devices.
requirements.test_case: Review the vehicle drawing for any additional reflectors and assess that they do not impair the mandatory lamps.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflectors shall be two in number, type-approved according to the requirements concerning Class IA or IB retro-reflectors in the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 3, or in the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 150.
requirements.test_case: Check the UN R3/R150 Class IA/IB approval certificate and approval marking on the reflector, and confirm that two units are installed.

requirements.text: That point on the illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Measure on the vehicle the distance from the outermost point of the illuminating surface to the vehicle's extreme outer edge (≤400 mm).

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be positioned above the ground not less than 250 mm nor more than 900 mm (not more than 1,200 mm if grouped with any rear lamp(s), 1,500 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 900 mm or 1200 mm respectively).
requirements.test_case: Measure the height of the illuminating surface above ground on the unladen vehicle against the 250–900/1,200 mm limits.

requirements.text: The rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall be positioned at the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Check the vehicle installation drawing or inspect the vehicle to confirm the reflector is located on the rear.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a horizontal angle of 30° inwards and outwards.
requirements.test_case: Verify the horizontal visibility angles of ±30° on the vehicle by CAD sight-line analysis or by measurement.

requirements.text: The geometric visibility of the rear retro-reflector, non-triangular, shall have a vertical angle of 10° above and below horizontal; however, where a retro-reflector is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 10° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.test_case: Verify the vertical visibility angles on the vehicle by CAD analysis, taking account of the mounting height relative to 750 mm.

requirements.text: The illuminating surface of the rear retro-reflector shall be permitted to have parts in common with the apparent surface of any other lamp situated at the rear.
requirements.test_case: Review the lamp drawing for any overlap between the reflector illuminating surface and the apparent surfaces of the other rear lamps, and confirm the overlap is with rear lamps only.

requirements.text: The emergency stop signal shall be given by the simultaneous operation of all the stop or direction-indicator lamps fitted as described in paragraph 6.23.7.
requirements.test_case: Check vehicle wiring/ESS activation: under emergency braking all stop lamps flash simultaneously as per 6.23.7.

requirements.text: Where a vehicle or electrical/electronic system or ESA does not include an electronic oscillator with an operating frequency greater than 9 kHz, it shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.3.2. or 6.6.2. and with Annexes 5 and 8.

Vehicles which do not have electrical/electronic systems with "immunity related functions" need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.4. and with Annex 6 to this Regulation.
ESAs with no immunity related functions need not be tested for immunity to radiated disturbances and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.8. and with Annex 9 to this Regulation.

Emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines. ESAs that are not switched, contain no switches or do not include inductive load need not be tested for transient conducted emission and shall be deemed to comply with paragraph 6.7.
